entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Founded in the 1960s–70s by Ed Roberts and others at UC Berkeley, the Independent Living Movement asserted that people with disabilities should have control over their own lives. It led to the creation of Centers for Independent Living worldwide and influenced the Americans with Disabilities Act.
